name: Didgori
armament: 7.62 mm M134 minigun or 12.7 mm NSV on roof
protection: Steel monocoque V-hull rated by the maker against 7.62x54R AP and small mines. Game: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R damages but rarely penetrates; 12.7 mm and launchers penetrate.
visual_notes: Armoured 4x4 built around a US full-size pickup chassis: long bonnet, upright armoured cab and box rear
Front and rear thermal/day cameras on small mounts; blow-away front wheel arches
Roof gunner position with minigun or NSV
